briefings.523:
<font:$local$\fonts\fonthead16bld.fnt>
MESSAGE FROM PRIEST KAIN
<font:$local$\fonts\font12.fnt>

We received a letter from Priest Kain confirming the rumors — his brother Bain was found in a Seljuk cage. In this region, they’re known for slave trading and see Bain only as profit, likely unaware of his importance as a priest.

They shouldn’t cause us too much trouble and may sell Bain for the right price in gold.

We should head there and ask for the price.

Raise the sails — course: northwest.
